hook: Data ke [[bouncers]]: NOT NULL, UNIQUE, DEFAULT

slides.title: Constraints = [[rules]]
points: Galat data aaya? DB **reject** kar dega
Bug app mein ho, data phir bhi **clean**
slides.note: Club ke bouncer: rule toda to **entry band** 🚫

slides.title: Table mein [[lagao]]
slides.code:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(100)
    UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  country VARCHAR(20)
    DEFAULT 'India'
);

slides.title: Bouncer ne [[roka]]
slides.note: Country diya hi nahi? **DEFAULT** ne 'India' bhar diya 🇮🇳

slides.title: CHECK [[bhi]] hai
slides.note: MySQL **8.0.16 se pehle** CHECK parse hota tha par enforce nahi 😅

slides.title: UNIQUE vs [[PRIMARY KEY]]
slides.note: UNIQUE mein NULL: Postgres/MySQL **kai NULL** chalne dete, SQL Server **sirf ek**

slides.wrong: UNIQUE aur PRIMARY KEY ko **same** samajhna
slides.right: PK = **UNIQUE + NOT NULL**, aur table mein **sirf ek**
slides.why: UNIQUE kai columns pe laga sakte ho, aur woh **NULL** le sakta hai
